tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body visual-novel sprite of Shenhe expressing smug, using the approved neutral as the identity, costume, proportion and rendering reference, and the supplied in-game image as an additional hair behavior reference. Let her long braid and hair hang naturally downward with the pose, guided by the in-game model, instead of perpetually streaming sideways in wind. Preserve identity, face, skin tone, hair, eyes, costume, accessories, colors and rendering. Preserve her Tall Female proportions, long braid and outfit. Show distinct expressive acting with a genuinely varied pose: a knowing smile, slightly lifted chin, one hand at the hip and the other near the chest. Keep normal pupils. Simple, readable hands near the torso; each visible hand has one anatomically correct thumb and four fingers connected to one palm and wrist. Do not force hidden digits into view. Exactly two legs and feet with an uncomplicated stance. Keep the entire silhouette including hair, headwear, accessories, hands and shoes visible, roughly 2–4% top and bottom padding, without lengthening the body. True transparent background. No scenery, text, UI, weapons, companions, floating effects or ground shadow.
